Subject: Redwood marketplace procurement & commercial path

Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so your procurement team has what they need: 

What we heard on the call:
- LumenAI is evaluating Redwood for inference (hosted + marketplace consumption path).
- Preferred procurement flow: AWS Marketplace listing preferred, but procurement can accept a standard PO if marketplace onboarding will add too much time.
- Typical internal procurement timeline: ~6–8 weeks for a PO and legal review.
- Security bar: SOC 2 Type II report required, plus standard data processing addendum (DPA).

Action items we promised: 
1) Send an SOW + indicative pricing for a 12-month committed Dedicated instance and hosted API fallback (attachment).
2) Clarify our AWS Marketplace options vs direct PO purchase and provide next steps for marketplace onboarding.
3) Provide SOC 2 report and DPA template link.

Quick questions for your procurement team (cc'ing Jonas so we can coordinate):
- Do you need Redwood to be listed on AWS Marketplace for the initial purchase, or is accepting a PO and prepaid invoice acceptable?
- Who is the procurement contact and what's the preferred billing entity?
- Any special PO terms we should be aware of (PO number format, invoicing cadence)?

I attached a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf) and our AWS marketplace onboarding overview. I can also open a short thread with your procurement contact if you prefer.

Available to sync next week if useful — thanks again!

—Camila

Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace procurement & commercial path

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the follow-up and the materials. Quick responses from Procurement: 

- Marketplace preference: AWS Marketplace is preferred for software procurement at LumenAI for SaaS, primarily for consolidated billing and easier renewals. That said, if marketplace onboarding will push us past our target launch, Procurement can accept a standard PO for an initial committed term and then move to marketplace for renewals.
- Billing: We will need to pay via PO issued to Redwood Inc (legal entity) — card payments are generally reserved for smaller subscriptions.
- Timeline: If we go PO-first, expect ~6–8 weeks for internal approvals and legal/finance signoff. If we go marketplace, onboarding tends to add 2–4 weeks depending on listing completeness and our vendor team bandwidth.

Requirements: 
- Please provide the SOW (received) and a one-page pricing summary that includes list price and a recommended marketplace listing price (if different).
- SOC 2 Type II report and DPA — procurement@lumenai.com will need links or PDFs.
- Our procurement team will also want to review your standard T&Cs; we may redline the Master Subscription Agreement (MSA).

I've looped in procurement@lumenai.com — Alex from procurement will own next steps. Alex, can you confirm preferred PO process and whether AWS Marketplace is a hard requirement for LumenAI or just the preferred path?

Thanks —
Alice
Head of Platform, LumenAI
alice.zhang@lumenai.com
